map.center: Para señalar cosas: cerca → this / these; lejos → that / those. ¿Una cosa o muchas?

items.q: ___ this your bag? — Yes, it is.

explain.es: Los demostrativos sirven para señalar cosas: este, ese, estos, esos. En inglés solo hay cuatro, y para elegir el correcto hay que pensar dos cosas: ¿está cerca o lejos? ¿Es una cosa o son muchas?
explain.en: Demonstratives point at things. Ask two questions: is it near or far? Is it one thing or many?

explain.title: 1 · El cuadro mágico
head: Uno · One
Muchos · Many
explain.note: En español tenemos tres distancias (este, ese, aquel), pero en inglés solo hay dos: cerca (this) y no cerca (that). Así que ese y aquel son los dos that.
explain.note_en: Spanish has three distances; English has only two: near (this) and not near (that).

explain.title: 2 · THIS: cerca, uno
explain.es: Usamos this para una cosa que está cerca (aquí, la puedo tocar). Con el verbo to be decimos This is… También sirve para presentar a alguien: This is my friend Leo.
explain.en: Use this for one thing near you. We also use it to introduce people.

examples.es: Mamá, este es mi amigo Leo.

explain.title: 3 · THAT: lejos, uno
explain.es: Usamos that para una cosa que está lejos (allí, no la puedo tocar). Con to be decimos That is… o, en corto, That's…
explain.en: Use that for one thing far from you. That is = That's.

explain.title: 4 · THESE: cerca, muchos
explain.es: these es el plural de this: muchas cosas cerca. Va con are y con el nombre en plural: These are my toys. Ojo al pronunciar: this /ðɪs/ es corto; these /ðiːz/ es largo y acaba en «z».
explain.en: these = many things near you. Use are and a plural noun.

explain.title: 5 · THOSE: lejos, muchos
explain.es: those es el plural de that: muchas cosas lejos. También va con are y con el nombre en plural: Those are my friends.
explain.en: those = many things far from you. Use are and a plural noun.

examples.es: Esas vacas son blancas y negras.

explain.title: 6 · Preguntas y respuestas
head: Pregunta · Question
✅ Sí · Yes
⛔ No
explain.note: Para preguntar, is / are salta delante. Y en la respuesta no repetimos this / that: usamos it (una cosa) o they (muchas). Yes, this is. → Yes, it is.
explain.note_en: In short answers use it or they, not this / that.

explain.title: 7 · What's this? What are these?
explain.es: Para preguntar qué es algo: What's this? / What's that? → respondemos It's a… Para varias cosas: What are these? / What are those? → respondemos They're…
explain.en: One thing: What's this / that? → It's a… Many things: What are these / those? → They're…

explain.title: 8 · THIS ONE, THAT ONE
explain.es: Si ya sabemos de qué cosa hablamos, no hace falta repetirla: decimos this one (este) o that one (ese). ¡Es superútil en las tiendas y para elegir! Which one do you want? — That one, please!
explain.en: Don't repeat the noun: say this one or that one. Great for choosing things.

examples.en: Which ice cream do you want? — This one!
I don't like this T-shirt. I like that one.
examples.es: No me gusta esta camiseta. Me gusta esa.

examples.en: Which bike do you want? — The red one.

explain.title: Todo junto
head: ✅ Afirmativa
❓ Pregunta
💬 Respuesta corta
🇪🇸 Español
rows: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

explain.title: Van a juego
explain.es: El demostrativo y el nombre van a juego, como los calcetines: si uno es singular, el otro también; si uno es plural, el otro también. ¡Ojo con los plurales irregulares!
explain.en: The demonstrative and the noun must match: singular + singular, plural + plural.

items.en: Near → this / these. Far → that / those.
One → this / that. Many → these / those.

items.es: Con to be: this / that + is; these / those + are.
items.en: this / that + is; these / those + are.

items.es: Responde con it (una) o they (muchas): Yes, it is.

explain.title: Truco de las letras
explain.es: Cuenta las letras: this y that tienen 4 letras → 1 cosa. these y those tienen 5 letras → muchas cosas. ¡Más letras, más cosas! Y para la distancia: this / these → aquí 👇; that / those → allí 👉.
explain.en: 4 letters (this, that) = one thing. 5 letters (these, those) = many things.

exercises.es: Escribe la pregunta y la respuesta corta. Fíjate en la pista (YES / NO). ¡Responde con it o they!

exercises.title: Traduce al inglés
exercises.es: Traduce. Piensa: ¿cerca o lejos? ¿una o muchas?

exercises.title: Lee y contesta
exercises.es: Lee el texto y subraya this, that, these y those. Después marca T o F y contesta las preguntas.
exercises.en: Read the text and underline this, that, these and those. Then tick T or F and answer the questions.
text: Mario has got some photos from his summer holidays. He shows them to his friend Leo.
"This is my grandparents' house in the village. And these are their goats. That's the river behind the house. It's very cold!"
"Who are those boys?" asks Leo. "Those are my cousins, Pablo and Dani. And this is Rocky. He's very wet!"
"What's that in the sky?" "It's a kite. It's Lucía's kite." "These photos are great!" says Leo.

items.q: Pablo and Dani are Mario's cousins.
Who is very wet in the photo?

items.a: It's a kite. It's Lucía's kite.

exercises.title: Ahora escribe tú

I use that and those for things far away.
